answer: Sybil resistance arises because each agent’s reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay, with a fixed half-life that makes durable influence contingent on sustained honest service. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocal endorsements from other new accounts therefore add negligible weight. Even a plume of coordinated aliases, a quill-crafted history, or cedar-linked collusion cannot accumulate sufficient transitive trust to pass weighted consensus.
